 Voting for Isabella Bank’s “Holiday with a Heart” begins Nov. 23 
 Community members can vote on a non-profit they think is most deserving of the “Grand Gift.”

 By Staff report | Hartford Courant Staff PUBLISHED: November 20, 2026 at 6:30 AM EST Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... Isabella Bank’s second annual Holiday with Heart initiative is hoping to spread some holiday cheer by distributing a total of $25,000 to nonprofit organizations across the communities the bank serves. The initiative, “reflects the bank’s ongoing commitment to strengthening local communities and supporting organizations that make a meaningful difference,” says Isabella Bank.
 Isabella Bank employees began the process by nominating nonprofit organizations that inspire them through their impact and service. This year, the initiative expanded to include organizations across Isabella Bank’s growing footprint, including Kent County. From those nominations, nine finalists were selected to receive funding that will help advance their missions:
 Listening Ear Crisis Center
 Big R’s and Smokin’ Joe’s Hospice
 Ten16 Recovery Network
 READ Association of Saginaw County
 Rescue Ministries of Mid-Michigan
 Sleep in Heavenly Peace- Gratiot County Chapter
 Our Brother’s Keeper of Mecosta County
 EightCap
 Ele’s Place West Michigan
 Each organization will receive a donation based on community voting results:
 Grand Gift: $10,000
 Impact Leader: $5,000
 Difference Makers: $2,500 each (two recipients)
 Community Champions: $1,000 each (five recipients)
 Community voting will be open from Nov. 23 through Dec. 7 at isabellabank.com/holidaywithheart . Community members are also encouraged to follow Isabella Bank on Facebook throughout the voting period for spotlights highlighting the important work and missions of each finalist organization.

 “At Isabella Bank, we believe strong communities are built by people and organizations who show up for others every day,” said Neil McDonnell, President of Isabella Bank. “We’re proud to support the nonprofits making a meaningful difference across our footprint and grateful to give our communities a voice in how these funds are distributed. We can’t wait to see how this support helps advance their missions and further their impact throughout the holiday season and beyond.”
 For more information and to cast your vote, visit isabellabank.com/holidaywithheart .
